Headline: SB #56 Milwaukee busesTemporary Southbound Reroute near Milwaukee/Campbell
ShortDescription: SB #56 Milwaukee buses are temporarily rerouted due to a street blockage near Milwaukee/Campbell.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Southbound #56 Milwaukee buses are temporarily rerouted via Milwaukee, California, Armitage, Milwaukee and over the regular route, due to a street blockage near Milwaukee/Campbell.

Northbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: #78 Montrose Temporary Reroute at Montrose/Milwaukee
ShortDescription: #78 Montrose buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to fire department activity near Montrose/Milwaukee.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#78 Montrose buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Montrose, Milwaukee, Sunnyside, Laramie, and Montrose then resume their regular route, due to fire department activity near Montrose/Milwaukee.

Allow extra travel time.
